identity_locks.Dedue: Academy-era Dedue: very tall, broad-shouldered young retainer, deep brown skin, short pale silver-white hair, calm guarded eyes, blue-black Blue Lions academy uniform, quiet protector posture, never villainous, never a brute.
identity_locks.Ashe: Academy-era Ashe: youthful gentle archer student, pale silver-gray short hair, clear earnest face, Blue Lions academy uniform with light archer details, honest and curious, never golden-haired, never elderly gray-haired.

dialogue.speaker: Ashe
dialogue.text: Were you a cook at the castle? Or did your family run an inn?

dialogue.speaker: Dedue
dialogue.text: No. My sister and I helped prepare meals at home.

dialogue.speaker: Ashe
dialogue.text: That's all? Then your home meals must have been incredible.

bridge_actions.text: A pond breeze moves the basket cloth.
Dedue lowers his gaze for a brief memory beat.
